title: Lightly Sweetened Japanese Malai Bao
description: A creamy and nostalgic Japanese dish featuring malai and a lightly sweetened bread, perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: Combine yeast and warm water in a small bowl, let it sit for 5 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch and salt.
Add sugar, milk and yeast mixture to the dry ingredients, mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Punch down the dough, divide it into 4-6 equal pieces, shape each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, place a tablespoon of malai in the center.
Fold the dough into a half moon shape, press the edges to seal, and use a fork to crimp the edges.
Heat a comal or griddle over medium heat, brush with coconut oil.
Cook the baos for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown.
Brush the tops with sugar syrup (1 tablespoon sugar dissolved in 1 tablespoon water) and let them cool.
